I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live weather data. However, I can give you a quick overview of what you can generally expect in San Francisco:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Weather Notes |
|--------|---------------------|---------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog, especially near the coast. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Mild, gradually warming, still some fog in early spring. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57–75 °F (14–24 °C) | Warm but rarely hot; coastal breezes keep temperatures comfortable. Fog can still roll in, especially in the mornings. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 58–73 °F (14–23 °C) | Pleasant, similar to summer, with decreasing fog as the season progresses. |

If you need the current forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather service such as the National Weather Service, Weather.com, or a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of how to interpret a weather forecast or anything else!
